claims.claim: Hugging Face publishes the Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard with covered benchmarks including HeQ, HebrewSentiment, Hebrew Winograd, Translation En<->He, and Hebrew Trivia (the canonical benchmark set this skill evaluates against).
The live Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard space is at huggingface.co/spaces/hebrew-llm-leaderboard/leaderboard.
claims.raw_snippet: Hebrew LLM Leaderboard - a Hugging Face Space by hebrew-llm-leaderboard

claims.claim: Dicta-LM 3.0 technical report (published February 2026 by Dicta) documents the 24B (Mistral-Small-3.1 base), 12B Nemotron (NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 base), and 1.7B (Qwen3-1.7B base) variants, plus a benchmark suite covering Translation, Summarization, Winograd, Israeli Trivia, and Diacritization.
Dicta publishes its Hebrew open-weight LLM family on Hugging Face under huggingface.co/dicta-il.
AI21's Jamba models list Hebrew (he) among their supported languages, alongside English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Arabic.
claims.verification_note: The previously cited ai21.com blog post returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients and could not be read, so the claim was re-sourced to the model's own card metadata on HuggingFace, where cardData.language includes 'he'. Note the AI21-Jamba model repos are gated ('gated': 'auto'), so the README itself is not fetchable unauthenticated; the API metadata is.

The Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard scores six tasks: SNLI Accuracy, QA TLNLS (HeQ), Sentiment Acc (Mafat), Winograd (Binary) Acc, Translation BLEU, and Israeli Trivia.

claims.claim: HebArabNlpProject/HebrewSentiment contains 43,645 rows (train 35,135 / validation 2,000 / test 6,510).
The leaderboard's Hebrew Winograd task has 278 examples.
The Israeli Trivia task comprises 300 examples.
The leaderboard's sentiment split is an early Mafat/NNLP-IL subset and is explicitly different from the data on the HebrewSentiment HuggingFace card.

claims.claim: AlephBench is a reproducible Hebrew LLM benchmark of 11 tasks with frozen prompts, licensed cc-by-4.0.
CohereLabs/Global-MMLU is a HuggingFace dataset that includes a Hebrew (he) configuration, used as the reproducible Hebrew MMLU route.
Current Claude model IDs are claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5 and claude-haiku-4-5, and they carry no date suffix.

claims.claim: Google's current stable Gemini ids include gemini-3.7-flash, gemini-3.5-flash and gemini-2.5-pro; gemini-3-pro-preview and gemini-3-flash-preview are preview-only.
AI21's callable Jamba model ids are the unversioned aliases jamba-large and jamba-mini plus versioned ids such as jamba-large-1.7 and jamba-mini-2.
The inspect_evals companion repo ships 171 pre-built evals.
The Hebrew Winograd resource file is hosted at cs.ubc.ca/~vshwartz/resources/winograd_he.jsonl and contains 278 items.
The gold label in HebArabNlpProject/HebrewSentiment lives in a field named tag_ids (values Positive/Negative/Neutral), not label.
